To follow what ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity say about a client and its rivals, consider HubSpot AEO. Its $50-per-brand monthly plan checks questions you choose each day. You can read the answers it collects to see whether the business is merely mentioned or actually recommended. [...] ## 3. HubSpot AEO: pay for daily checks on questions you choose

A client asking “Does ChatGPT recommend us over our competitor?” needs a different kind of evidence. Their own site might be cited without the business being recommended. Equally, an answer could recommend them using information from another website.

HubSpot AEO, currently in beta, lets you follow chosen prompts, inspect returned answers and see the brands and sources involved. What Is AI Visibility?

## What Is AI Visibility?

AI visibility is how often and how clearly your brand appears in AI-generated answers across platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Mode, and AI Overviews. It shows whether AI search platforms mention your brand when people ask questions related to your products, services, category, or competitors.

Strong AI visibility means your brand is more likely to appear in relevant answers, be described accurately, and be included when users compare options.

Low AI visibility can mean AI platforms don’t mention your brand, mention competitors instead, or describe your brand in a limited or inaccurate way.
